ood._score_note: MaxLogit (Hendrycks 2019) is theoretically robust under temperature scaling and label smoothing where MSP collapses. Disabled on this model because the calibration set below shows NEGATIVE separation — NAP medians sit ABOVE plant medians, so a floor that hits the target_plant_fpr=0.05 (plant_p05=1.62) catches zero NAPs (nap_p05=3.22). _should_route_to_nap therefore degrades to a detector-confidence-only gate; OOD is left to the classifier's own not_a_plant head until a different score (energy/MSP/etc.) is calibrated.

_calibration._separation_note: separation_p50 < 0 means MaxLogit gives the WRONG-SIGN signal on this model — NAPs score higher than plants on the metric. Any positive floor here would over-fire on real plants; any floor low enough to spare plants misses every NAP. Hence max_logit_floor=null above.
